4. The relevant facts for disposal of this rule, inter alia, are that Alhaj Sheikh Mohammed Noor, the father of the present petitioner, purchased 30.50 acres of land from the SA Recorded owner comprising in Mouza-Kouchakuri, Police Station Kaliakoir, District-Gazipur as mentioned in the writ petition. The present petitioner's father purchased the aforementioned lands during the period between 1962 to 1966 through different deeds annexed as Annexures. The said Sheikh Mohammad Noor being an owner and possessor of the aforesaid land mutated his name in the concerned office of the Assistant Commissioner (Land) and paid rent after obtaining Duplicate Carbon Receipt (DCR). The name of the said Sheikh Mohammad Noor was recorded in the RS Khatian in the right of record. The Petitioner claimed that she has been paying rent in the name of her predecessor. 

 20. The admitted position for both the parties are that the disputed land was owned and possessed by one Sheikh Mohammad Noor after obtaining record of right in the RS Khatian in his name. The land measuring 30.50 acres is the disputed land situated in Mouza Kouchakuri, Police Station-Kaliakoir and District-Gazipur which was purchased by the said Mohammad Noor through deeds of purchase which have been annexed in the writ petition.
